Kaaragar bina himmat himmat nahi.
Sahas sabse zaroori gun hai; bina iske koi bhi dusra gun lagataar nahi nibhaya ja sakta.
Silence woh space hai jahan answers aate.
Grit wahi lagan hai jab duniya kehti hai ruk jao, tab bhi aage badhte rehna.
Courage dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabja, dar ki kami nahi.
Perseverance hai nineteen dafa fail hona aur twentieth pe succeed karna.
Grit vijeta banati hai.
Jeetne ke liye aapko ek hi ladai baar-baar ladni pad sakti hai.
Khamoshi gehrai hai.
Grit ka matlab kaam se mohabbat.
Grit excellence tak bridge hai.
Silence sabse powerful scream hai.
Khamoshi golden; par action bhi gold hai.
Grit dil ki lagan aur jidd hai.
Yeh maayne nahi rakhta ki aap kitna dheere chal rahe hain, bas rukna mat.
Grit grit hi hai.
Grit sacrifice maangta.
